services.name: Jet Ski Rentals
services.desc: Nashville Shores Lakeside Resort is your gateway to Percy Priest Lake, and we have teamed up with Cap’n Dave’s Water Sports to provide you with many exciting activities for the ultimate lake experience. If you have a need for speed, you can rush across the lake on one of their jet skis. Or if you are looking for a more relaxing experience, enjoy a paddleboard, kayak, peddle boat, or canoe. If you do not wish to visit Nashville Shores Waterpark, you can still just rent jet skis or the other water activities.
